Method of Attack: Distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack using a botnet of trojanized Android apps
Layer 7 (application-level) DDoS attacks targeting Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) and content providers
Exhausting server memory resources and taking down online services
Discoverer: Researchers from Akamai, Cloudflare, Flashpoint, RiskIQ, Google, Oracle Dyn, Team Cymru, FBI
Impacted Systems: Company A’s online booking system website
Attack Vector: Trojanized apps distributed via Google Play Store and third-party app stores
Indicators of Compromise: More than 120,000 unique IP addresses observed in attacks
axclick.store sub-domains used as command and control infrastructure
